periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high aspect ratio where the vertical-diagonal length is significantly greater than the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower extremity of the patch ending in a narrow point well below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape along the posterior boundary across the shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is thick, encompassing approximately 35% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved, semicircular apex with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow tinting of the white fur on the lumbar and rump sections compared to the brighter white of the head.
